item.title: [David Gibson] Macronix leaving ROM buisness (Switch 1/2 ROM supplier)
item.author: invalid@example.com (RavensShade)
item.dc:creator: RavensShade
item.content:encoded: Reported by David Gibson from Macronix Q3 financial briefing. Macronix, 1 of, but not the sole supplier, of ROM for Nintendo Switch 1 and 2 games is backing out of the ROM business, while increasing eMMC and NAND production. Code: 1/4 Nintendo's main memory chip maker is quitting the Switch business Macronix, which makes the ROM chips in Switch 1 and Switch 2 game memory cards, is phasing out that business. There will be no new ROM products, and Q3 is the last quarter it reports ROM sales... Read more

item.author: invalid@example.com (Ruffy666)
item.dc:creator: Ruffy666
item.content:encoded: I thought I knew what I was getting with the "pinnacle of HD-2D" praise that was being thrown around, but I guess what I'm realizing is HD-2D is not the same thing as pixel art. I was imagining a game more like Octopath Traveler 2, which is IMO the true pinnacle of (what I thought was) HD-2D. Instead it's a mish-mosh of some pixel art, some rather sterile rendered assets and then some extremely elaborate fully-rendered cut scenes.
